project_type: React SPA (Vite) with Node.js BFF backend
build_system: Vite 8 with npm; esbuild transforms .js files as JSX
test_framework: Vitest with jsdom environment, Playwright for E2E
build_command: cd demo_api_ui && HTTPS=false npx vite build
test_command: cd demo_api_ui && HTTPS=false npx vitest run --reporter=verbose
verification_instructions: Run vite build (no TLS) to confirm no compilation errors. The test suite is available but may timeout in sandbox -- use build verification as primary signal.
environment_constraints: Dependencies installed via npm. No Docker daemon. TLS certs not available so HTTPS=false required. Vitest may timeout in sandbox -- use vite build as primary verification.
contribution_requirements: Use existing CSS class prefixes. Follow PingOneMcpInspector.js as the reference implementation for Mock B pattern.
key_patterns: PingOneMcpInspector.js is the gold standard Mock B implementation: p1mcp-* CSS classes, three-column grid (240px/380px/1fr), top bar with status dot, tree column with search/groups, form column with tool name/desc/params/Execute/Clear, output column with tabs/JSON/footer. All components use JsonHighlight from shared/JsonHighlight.jsx for syntax highlighting. apiClient from services/apiClient for HTTP calls.
directory_structure: demo_api_ui/src/components/ contains all UI components. Shared utilities in demo_api_ui/src/components/shared/. CSS co-located with components. Tests in demo_api_ui/src/components/__tests__/.
